title: The Output Convergence Debate Revisited: Lessons from recent developments in the analysis of panel data models
hypothesis: Relaxing parallel trends and dynamic homogeneity via DCCE (DCCEP homogeneous slopes, DCCEMG heterogeneous) substantially raises estimated speed of convergence and reduces mean lag versus Barro (-b_T) and TWFE, eliminating asymptotic downward bias that tends to zero when factor is trended; Headline estimates are DCCEMG per capita phi=-0.113 (0.012) mean lag 6.1 (0.83) vs TWFE -0.027 (0.004) 27.1 (3.82) vs Barro phi 0.0032 (0.0014) 316 (137) to 0.0037 per capita and 0.0049-0.0058 per employee; per employee DCCEMG -0.144 (0.015) mean lag 5.1 (0.69); capital long-run DCCEMG 0.484 (0.122) per capita 0.481 (0.084) per employee ~ capital share 0.46; democracy long-run falls from TWFE 21.24 (7.21) n=175 /21.53 (7.47) n=148 to DCCEP 5.77 (3.59) n=148 /DCCEMG* 5.90 (3.06) n=148 /DCCEMG 4.30 (3.01) n=73 losing significance; time-invariant ethno -1.708 (0.608) TWFE per capita -3.062 (1.341) DCCEP and protection 0.699 (0.122) 0.952 (0.236) significant latitude 0.383 (1.289) 0.832 (2.568) not significant  Headline claims: panar_phi_per_capita_DCCEMG panar_meanlag_per_capita_DCCEMG panar_phi_per_employee_DCCEMG panar_meanlag_per_employee_DCCEMG capital_longrun_per_capita_DCCEMG capital_longrun_per_employee_DCCEMG barro_phi_hat_per_capita_spec1 barro_mean_lag_per_capita_spec1 barro_restriction_t_per_capita barro_restriction_t_per_employee democracy_longrun_acemoglu_TWFE_175 democracy_longrun_DCCEMG_73 timeinv_ethnoling_TWFE_per_capita timeinv_protection_TWFE_per_capita

replication_notes Only printed numbers are claims; window lengths/lags/thresholds are parameters listed separately; p-values for restriction and comparison tests not printed => not stated per instruction and tests that would require them are either omitted or reported with p_value not stated; partitions with unprinted complement counts (e.g. 157=>100 leaves 57) are omitted  All SEs are heteroskedasticity robust (Huber-White for TWFE, DCCE robust for DCCEP/DCCEMG) or clustered by country for democracy TWFE as noted  Speed phi =1-sum rho = -coeff on y_{t-1} in ECM; barro phi =1-(1+b_T)^{1/T}  Mean lags computed as (1-phi-psi1-psi2)/phi  DCCE uses generalized inverse for collinear avg when factor trended

code_requirements 1. xtdcce2 for DCCEP/DCCEMG with generalized inverse, s_T lags of bar{y},bar{k},bar{d} as listed; 2. Barro NLS for phi and delta method SE for mean lag; 3. TWFE with two-way within and clustered SEs for democracy; 4. time-invariant second stage OLS of ahat on z with robust SE  Unbalanced panel handling via Wansbeek-Kapteyn incomplete panel within transform

sample: Penn World Tables v10.01 real GDP at constant 2017 national prices in million 2017US$ 'rgdpna'. Y_{it} scaled by POP_{it} => y_{it}=log(Y_{it}/POP_{it}) output per capita and by EMP_{it} => tilde{y}_{it}=log(Y_{it}/EMP_{it}) output per employee. Capital K_{it} 'rnna' scaled analogously k_{it}=log(K_{it}/POP_{it}), tilde{k}_{it}=log(K_{it}/EMP_{it}). Baseline panel: countries with >=30 yearly observations => n=157 baseline. For panel AR(3)/ARDL analyses unbalanced with T_{i} >=26 usable after lags. Barro cross-section uses balanced 1990-2019 T=29 n=157. Democracy analysis uses Acemoglu et al.(2019) replication data 1960-2010: original n=175 Tave=36.2 Tmin=6 Tmax=47; filtered to T_{i}>=24 (usable Tmin=20) => n=148 Tave=40 Tmax=47; time-varying democracy subsample n=73 Tave=41.3 Tmin=20 Tmax=47 of the n=148. Time-invariant second stage: n=100 countries with latitude, ethnic fractionalization, protection from expropriation and PPP diff available; first stage ARDL(2,2) estimated on n=157 with Tmax=68 Tmin=48 per capita Tave=63 and Tmin=38 per employee Tave=61.
method: 1. Define y_{it} and tilde{y}_{it} as above. Compute GLO global factor as PPP-weighted mean of logs for Asia, Europe, North America; verify trended with mean growth 2.4% p.a.

2. Barro regression. For balanced n=157 1990=T, 0=1990 estimate (4): y_{iT}-y_{i0}=a_{T}+b_{T}y_{i0}+c_{T}(y_{i0}-y^{PPP}_{i0})+zeta_{iT} by OLS and NLS. b_{T}=-(1-rho^{T}). Recover phi=1-rho=1-(1+b_{T})^{1/T}, theta = -[(1-(1+b_{T})^{1/T})/b_{T}]c_{T}. Mean lag=(1-phi)/phi. Heteroskedasticity-robust SE.

3. Panel AR without covariates. Estimate TWFE (1): y_{it}=alpha_{i}+f_{t}+ rho y_{i,t-1}+u_{it} and heterogeneous interactive form (5): y_{it}=alpha_{i}+gamma_{i}f_{t}+rho_{i}y_{i,t-1}+u_{it} with p=3. Convert to ECM (6). TWFE uses within M_{T}=I-TauTau'/T. DCCEP augments with bar{y}_{ot}, bar{y}_{o,t-1}, bar{y}_{o,t-2}, bar{y}_{o,t-3}; p_{T}=3,q_{T}=3,s_{T}=3 => rho_DCCEP in (11) using M_{bar{h}} with bar{H}=(tau,bar{y},bar{y}_{-1}) generalized inverse. DCCEMG uses (12) y_{it}=alpha_{in}-gamma_{i}psi(1)bar{mu}_{n}+gamma_{i}sum_{s=0}^{p_T}psi_{s}bar{y}_{o,t-s}+rho_{i}y_{i,t-1}+zeta_{it,n} with p_{T}=3,q_{T}=4; individual phi_{i,DCCE} in (14) using bar{W}_{i}=(tau,bar{y}_{o},...,bar{y}_{o,-qT}, Delta y_{i,-1}..) generalized inverse; phi_DCCEMG =n^{-1}sum phi_{i,DCCE} (15) Var=n^{-1}(n-1)^{-1}sum(phi_{i}-phi_MG)^2 (16). Unbalanced bar{y}_{ot}=n_{t}^{-1}sum_{i in t}y_{it}.

4. Panel AR with capital. Estimate (17) Delta y_{it}=alpha_{i}-phi_{i}y_{i,t-1}+sum_{s=1}^{pT-1}delta_{is}Delta y_{i,t-s}+beta_{i}'x_{it}+sum lambda' Delta x+psi_{i0}'bar{w}_{ot}+sum psi' Delta bar{w}+u_{it}, x=k or tilde{k}, bar{w}=(bar{y},bar{k}), s_{T}=4 for DCCEMG (3 for DCCEP), p_{T}=3. Long run = -beta/phi. TWFE/DCCEP/DCCEMG as above. Stata xtdcce2.

5. Democracy. Use Acemoglu dichotomous d_{it}. Estimate Delta y_{it}=alpha_{i}-phi y_{i,t-1}+sum_{1}^{3}psi Delta y_{t-l}+beta d_{it}+gamma_{i}'f_{t}+u_{it}. TWFE 4 lags. DCCEP/DCCEMG* impose homogeneous beta on n=148 with bar{y}, bar{d} averages from n=148, s_{T}=4 (bar{y}_{o,t}..bar{y}_{o,t-4}, bar{d}_{ot}). DCCEMG allows heterogeneous beta on n=73 varying d only, averages still n=148. Long run = beta/phi.

6. Time-invariant effects. First stage obtain psi_hat = psi_TWFE or psi_DCCEP from ARDL(2,2) in (y,k). Second stage filter a_{iT}=bar{y}_{io}-bar{q}_{io}'psi_hat (19). Regress a_{iT}=alpha_T+theta'z_{i}+eta_{iT}+bar{u}_{io} on z=(abs latitude, ethnic frac, protection expropriation, y_{1990}-y^{PPP}_{1990})/100 by OLS (20)-(22). Heteroskedasticity-robust SE. n=100.
